name: Mr. Chicken's Totally Ethical Farm
summary:
Start with just a single chicken and work your way up to a profitable megafarm by using mechanics such as breeding and automation. Increase farm size and unlock and combine breeds to create the most profitable chicken line to have ever existed. Utilize your eggs in different ways by packaging them up or converting them into other means.
Place machines and feed/medicate your chickens to success, use different stations to maximize your profits and efficiency!

Chickens have varying stats such as Lay Speed, Hunger Rate, etc; breed different genetics to create the ultimate chicken. Make use of different consumables and genetics to maximize your efficiency and then set-up your logistics to synergize
